name: Jumping snail
summary: Sông Cầu’s jumping snail, also called ốc đực, with crisp, sweet, fatty meat the color of chicken fat. Order it steamed with lemongrass and dipped in mắm gừng.
origin: Phu Yen. The snail comes from the Sông Cầu sea.
texture: Crisp, sweet, and fatty, with meat the color of chicken fat.
howToEat: Steam it with lemongrass and dip it in mắm gừng.
where: Sông Cầu, which also serves ốc giấm, ốc nón, ốc gai, ốc mỡ, ốc giác, ốc bàn tay, and ốc đỏ.
seoTitle: Oc nhay in Song Cau — steamed with lemongrass
seoDescription: Jumping snail from Song Cau, crisp and sweet, steamed with lemongrass and dipped in mam gung.
